source_metadata.question:
What is the area of the shaded region of the given $8 \times 5$ rectangle?

source_metadata.subject: metric geometry - area

target.visual_information: Multiple filled pieces separated by unfilled parts of the surrounding figure. On the left, use the two hatched triangular regions ABE and DCE. On the right, use the gray patches at the upper-left and lower-right corners of the rectangle.
target.left_evidence: The two hatched triangular regions ABE and DCE.
target.right_evidence: The gray patches at the upper-left and lower-right corners of the rectangle.
target.left_meaning: The hatch selects two separate triangles of parallelogram ABCD.
target.right_meaning: The fill selects two corner regions separated by unshaded parts of the rectangle.
target.reason: In each figure the fill specifies the components included in a total area. The unfilled pieces do not contribute to that total.
target.reasoning_consequence: Correctly interpreting the markings means adding the two hatched triangle areas and leaving out the two unhatched triangles on the left and adding the two gray corner areas without counting the rest of the rectangle on the right.
